ASSISTANT: Yes, with Premium you can have up to 4 simultaneous streams. Has she been having any issues?

ASSISTANT: We've added a lot of original content though - Stranger Things, Wednesday, The Crown.

ASSISTANT: Yes, with Premium you can download on up to 6 devices.

ASSISTANT: You could switch to the Disney+ and Hulu bundle only, which is $19.99 - the same price actually.
USER: Wait, it's the same price without ESPN?
ASSISTANT: Yes, the bundle pricing makes the full trio the better value. Disney+ alone is $13.99 and Hulu alone is $17.99.
USER: So separately they'd be $31.98?
ASSISTANT: Exactly. The bundle saves you about $12 per month.
USER: That's significant. When did I sign up for this?
ASSISTANT: You started with just Disney+ in January 2024, then upgraded to the bundle in June 2024.
USER: What made me upgrade?
ASSISTANT: The notes show you called about adding Hulu for The Bear season 3.
USER: Oh yeah, great show! What's my billing date?
ASSISTANT: You're billed on the 5th of each month. Next payment is November 5th.
USER: And payment method?
ASSISTANT: You have a Mastercard ending in 9023 on file.
USER: That's the right card. How many people can use my account?
ASSISTANT: Disney+ allows 4 concurrent streams and up to 7 profiles. Hulu allows 2 concurrent streams.
USER: My kids each have their own profile, right?
ASSISTANT: Yes, I see profiles for Kids, Teen, and one called Dad - that's yours?
USER: Yes, very creative naming! Can I download shows?
ASSISTANT: Yes, Disney+ allows downloads on up to 10 devices. Hulu allows downloads on 5 devices with your plan.
USER: Good to know. What new Marvel shows are coming?
ASSISTANT: Daredevil: Born Again is coming in 2025, and there's Agatha All Along available now.
USER: I haven't watched Agatha yet. Is it good?
ASSISTANT: It's getting positive reviews. It's a WandaVision spinoff.
USER: Oh, I loved WandaVision! Speaking of which, are all Marvel movies on Disney+?
ASSISTANT: Most are, but Spider-Man movies aren't due to Sony's rights.
USER: That's annoying. Where can I watch those?
ASSISTANT: They rotate between different platforms. Currently some are on Netflix, others on digital rental.
USER: What about Star Wars content?
ASSISTANT: All Star Wars content is exclusive to Disney+. Ahsoka, Mandalorian, Andor, all here.
USER: Good. My son loves Mandalorian. Is season 4 coming?
ASSISTANT: Yes, The Mandalorian season 4 is in production, expected in 2025.
USER: What about parental controls?
ASSISTANT: Each profile can have different maturity ratings set. Your Kids profile is already set to TV-PG.
USER: Perfect. Can I watch Hulu content through the Disney+ app?
ASSISTANT: Not yet, but they're working on integrating everything into one app.
USER: That would be convenient. How's the 4K content?
ASSISTANT: Most Disney+ originals and movies are in 4K. Hulu has select content in 4K.
USER: Do I need special equipment?
ASSISTANT: You need a 4K TV and compatible streaming device, plus internet speed of at least 25 Mbps.
USER: I have all that. Oh, can I use this internationally?
ASSISTANT: Disney+ works in many countries, but content varies by region. Hulu only works in the US.
USER: So Hulu won't work when I travel?
ASSISTANT: Correct, unless you use a VPN, though that's against terms of service.
USER: Got it. Is there a discount for annual payment?
ASSISTANT: Yes, if you pay annually, the bundle is $219.99, saving you about $20 per year.
USER: Not a huge saving.
ASSISTANT: True, monthly gives more flexibility to change or cancel.
USER: I'll stick with monthly. Can I pause my subscription?
ASSISTANT: We don't offer pause, but you can cancel and resubscribe anytime without losing your profiles.
USER: Good to know. Any price increases coming?
ASSISTANT: Nothing announced currently. We typically give 30 days notice of any price changes.
USER: Fair enough. Thanks for all the info Maria!
ASSISTANT: You're welcome! Enjoy your streaming, Mr. Johnson!
